D: Riley heads to hockey camp as a teenager and a crowd of new emotions moves into headquarters.
P: Serve the snacks when Anxiety arrives at Headquarters.
S: Hockey camp pretzel bites and cheese dip

Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with a warm cheddar sauce. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 30g melted butter and 250ml warm water and knead 5 minutes. Rest 1 hour. Roll into long ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb, drop the bites in for 20 seconds, then drain onto a lined tray. Brush with egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk and stir in 150g cheddar for dipping.
Cheddar, crackers, grapes, almonds, carrots, hummus. A real pickle, Bloofy.

A bit of everything on one big board: cheddar, crackers, grapes, roasted almonds, baby carrots and hummus, so nobody is caught short. Arrange cubes of cheddar, water crackers, bunches of red grapes, roasted almonds, baby carrots and a bowl of hummus on one big board. Fill every gap. Then add a few more crackers just in case, because you can never be too prepared.
Popcorn coated in honey butter, brown sugar and turmeric

Popcorn tossed in a bubbling honey butter glaze, baked until crunchy and glowing golden, finished with a pinch of flaky salt. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a lidded pot and tip into a large roasting tin. Melt 80g butter with 80g honey, 2 tbsp brown sugar and a pinch of turmeric for colour, and bubble for 2 minutes. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake at 150C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway, then spread on baking paper to cool and crisp. Sprinkle with flaky salt and serve in a big bowl.
M: Camp cafeteria chicken broccoli pasta bake
lunch in the hockey camp cafeteria

Penne mixed with chicken, broccoli and a creamy parmesan and garlic sauce, topped with cheese and baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 400g penne until 2 minutes short of al dente, adding 1 head broccoli in florets for the last 2 minutes, then drain. Melt 40g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 700ml milk until thick and stir in 60g parmesan. Fold in the pasta, broccoli and 400g shredded cooked chicken. Tip into a baking dish, top with 150g grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Spiced beef mince tacos in crisp shells with toppings
Beef mince cooked with cumin, paprika and tomato, served in taco shells with lettuce, tomato, cheddar and sour cream.
W: Fudgy brownies, a team Anger can get behind

Dense dark chocolate brownies with a crackly top, baked fudgy in the middle and cut into thick squares for the team after practice. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter. Whisk in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C for 28 minutes and cool before cutting.
K: Honey and apple juice over ice. Ennui says non.
Chamomile tea brewed with honey, cooled, mixed with apple juice and poured over ice.
